decision_summary: Freeze a skew-favoring mixed policy after matched development runs: skew achieved lower energy at n=47 and 67, while unrestricted search won at n=31. EV010 rejects mandatory optimal balance at n=18; EV002 verifies balanced existence separately. The evaluation budget is exhausted.
expected_information: No further experiments. Evidence supports a provisional operational choice only; strict skew enforcement and robustness across additional matched seeds remain unresolved, and development witnesses do not establish optimality.

policy.decision_summary: Increase skew allocation from 0.5 to 0.65 based on EV007 and EV009, retaining unrestricted allocation because EV004 beats EV005. Impose no balance restriction. Retain tested tabu, restart and perturbation defaults; the allocation itself is untested and strict skew enforcement remains unresolved.
